name: Fault Acknowledgment and Reset
description: Standard two-step fault reset. Fault latches on any safety event. Reset only when all conditions are safe AND operator presses Reset_PB.
safety_notes: Never allow Reset_PB to clear fault without verifying all safety conditions. Step_State must return to 0 on reset to prevent resuming mid-sequence.
common_mistakes: Reset without checking E-Stop health — allows reset while still in danger
Not resetting Step_State — sequence resumes from mid-point after reset
